INTRO
The ancient city stood proudly above the sea.
Its great walls protected thousands of families.
Merchants brought silk and spices from distant lands.
Section 2: The Siege
In spring the sultan gathered a massive army.
Enormous cannons pounded the stone defenses daily.
Defenders repaired breaches every single night.
Hunger and fear spread across the crowded streets.
Section 3: The Fall
Finally the final assault began before dawn.
Soldiers poured through the broken gate.
The empire ended and a new age began.
